description: UKOJOX crystallizes in the monoclinic crystal system with space group C 2. Reported CIF formula moiety: C104 H83 Dy3 N8 O17,C1 H2 Cl2. From the CIF bond table, Dy1 (Dy) has 6 O neighbors; Dy2 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy3 (Dy) has 6 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 2 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a chain with approximately linear metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.975-3.975 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 110.90-117.86°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [Dy3(L1)2(dbm)5(CH3OH)]·CH2Cl2 (C104H83Dy3N8O17·CH2Cl2).
